context:
Goal: a turn never sends a second reply just to satisfy the report guard.
Problem (rule): your 16:23 CST ruling asks for the full report only on turns that push, but the report guard also asks on turns that commit, merge or open a PR, so those still send a second reply unless you widen your rule.
Based on (notes): lane tracking-turn-report-clash, PR #966, Nov 1 16:35 CST.
Based on (read): the double replies you saw came from turns the guard flagged where nothing was pushed (the lane's read).
Departs from: main (a turn that only tracks work gets one line, with no report exception) — PR #966 adds the exception for turns that push; option B widens it to turns that land work (commit, push, merge or PR).

This does not block: PR #966 is built with "pushes" and changes one word for option B.

options.gain: The rule matches your words exactly.
options.how: Only a turn that pushes ends with the full report.
options.label: Keep "pushes", as you ruled
options.lose: A turn that only commits or merges can still send one line and then a second reply for the guard.

options.gain: The rule matches every turn the guard checks, so no double reply.
options.how: A turn that commits, pushes, merges or opens a PR ends with the full report.
options.label: Widen to "lands"
options.lose: A few more small turns end with a report block.

ref: PR #966 (tracking turns and the report); step tracking-turn-report-clash (the one-line rule clashes with the report rule)
title: Which turns must end with the full report: ones that push, or any that land work?
why: The double replies came from turns the guard flagged where nothing was pushed; only b stops those.
